title: Libellula Movement Studio

explain.meaning: A slower yoga style that holds each pose, good for beginners.

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: At Libellula Movement Studio, Sidneys Pilates Studio, clients are hand selected and placed into classes that best meet their goals, schedule, and experience, with room to grow, strengthen and expand their skillset. Clients keep their weekly spot on an ongoing basis which allows them to grow and strengthen their skill at a consistent space, and never worrying about not getting into there class.
